label: Cloud
note: Cloud or no data; not a land cover

label: Forest fire/burnt area
note: Burnt area is a transient disturbance state, not counted as natural

label: Peatland
note: Peatland in the ACI is exploited (harvested) peatland, so not natural cover

label: Grassland
note: Native or unimproved grassland; cannot be separated from some tame grass

label: Agriculture (undifferentiated)
note: Undifferentiated agriculture, used where ground data were missing; counted as crop

label: Pasture/forages
note: Pasture and perennial forage (hay, alfalfa, tame grass); NOT crop by default, see README

label: Too wet to be seeded
note: Agricultural land too wet to seed; counted as crop (cultivated land)

label: Fallow
note: Fallow is part of the crop rotation; counted as crop

label: Switchgrass
note: Switchgrass, a cultivated perennial; counted as crop
